request.query: reconstruct a polynomial remainder by summing monomials of coefficients below degree of monic divisor

items.name: Polynomial.sum_modByMonic_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {n : ℕ}, q.degree ≤ ↑n → ∑ i, (Polynomial.monomial ↑i) ((p %ₘ q).coeff ↑i) = p %ₘ q

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → p %ₘ q = p - q * (p /ₘ q)

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → p %ₘ q + q * (p /ₘ q) = p

items.name: Polynomial.divModByMonicAux
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → Polynomial R → {q : Polynomial R} → q.Monic → Polynomial R × Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_mod
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Field R] {q : Polynomial R} (p : Polynomial R), q.Monic → p %ₘ q = p % q
